agent_findings.finding: Correct password entered but OTP not verified within 120s window. 3 login retries from same session.
Source IP 185.220.101.47 flagged on AbuseIPDB with 91% abuse confidence score, reported 214 times in past 90 days.
No anomalous local process activity detected on the registered device during the incident window.
Login origin geolocation (Moscow) inconsistent with user's baseline location (Puducherry, India) established over 60-day history.

actions_taken.action: Temporarily blocked source IP for 30 minutes
Sent push + email confirmation request to registered user

recommendation_hint: Recommend permanent IP block and mandatory password reset if user denies the login attempt.
